items.t: Said no Californian should be unable to secure housing, a loan, or a job because they accessed necessary medical care.
items.q: No Californian should be unable to secure housing, a loan, or even a job because they accessed necessary medical care. California is stepping up to protect consumers impacted by the effects of medical debt.

items.t: Said SB 354 gives consumers control of their most sensitive data and holds insurers and their vendors accountable for protecting it.
items.q: Californians should not have to wonder who has their personal information. SB 354 gives consumers control of their most sensitive data and holds insurers and their vendors accountable for protecting that data.

record.office: President pro Tempore, California State Senate
record.t: Was elected to the California State Senate in November 2020, representing the 21st Senate District.
record.q: Senate President pro Tempore Monique Limón was elected to the Senate in November 2020 and represents the 21st Senate District, which includes Santa Barbara County and parts of Ventura and San Luis Obispo Counties.

record.office: President pro Tempore, California State Senate
record.t: Was chosen by her Senate colleagues to lead the Senate as President pro Tempore.
record.q: Before being chosen by her colleagues to lead the Senate, Monique served as the Assemblymember for the region.

record.t: Presented over $2 million in funding to the Lompoc Theatre Project for renovation efforts.
record.q: State Senator Monique Limón presented over $2 million in funding to the Lompoc Theatre Project to aid in the renovation efforts.

record.t: Authored legislation to keep medical debt from hurting consumer credit scores, which Governor Gavin Newsom signed.
record.q: Legislation authored by Senator Monique Limón to ensure medical debt does not hurt consumer credit scores, has been signed by Governor Gavin Newsom.

record.t: Authored SB 354, the Insurance Information and Privacy Protection Act, which sets standards for how insurance licensees and their vendors handle personal information.
record.q: Authored by President pro Tempore Limón and sponsored by Commissioner Lara, SB 354 sets clear standards for how insurance licensees and their third-party vendors collect, process, and share personal information.

record.t: Authored SB 442, which expands the definition of misdemeanor sexual battery to include forcing a victim to touch an intimate body part of the perpetrator or another person.
record.q: Authored by Senator Monique Limón and sponsored by Ventura County District Attorney Erik Nasarenko, SB 442 expands the definition of misdemeanor sexual battery to include instances where a perpetrator forces a victim to touch the intimate body part of the perpetrator or another person.

record.t: Authored SB 1101 to expand the use of beneficial fire; it passed the Legislature unanimously and was signed by Governor Gavin Newsom.
record.q: On Friday night, Senator Monique Limón’s legislation to expand the use of beneficial fire was signed by Governor Gavin Newsom. SB 1101 passed out of the California State Legislature with bipartisan, unanimous support.
